title: Grade 8 Science — Fri, Jun 20
description: Coal and Petroleum — Day 5 of 5: Mixed review
subject: science

questions.question: Which correctly matches the fuel with its primary source?
questions.explanation: Coke is obtained from coal (destructive distillation). Petrol is obtained from petroleum (fractional distillation).

questions.question: Which process is used for coal → coke? Which for petroleum → petrol?
options: Coal: destructive distillation; petroleum: fractional distillation
Coal: fractional distillation; petroleum: destructive distillation
questions.explanation: Coal uses destructive distillation (no air, heat → coke + coal tar + gas). Petroleum uses fractional distillation (boiling point separation).

questions.question: Which of the following is found in coal tar and is used as a starting material for making many chemicals?
questions.explanation: Benzene is a key component of coal tar and is used as a raw material for making dyes, medicines, plastics, and explosives.

questions.question: The correct order of petroleum fractions from LOWEST to HIGHEST boiling point is:
options: Petrol → kerosene → diesel → lubricating oil → bitumen
Bitumen → lubricating oil → diesel → kerosene → petrol
Diesel → petrol → kerosene → lubricating oil → bitumen
Petrol → diesel → kerosene → bitumen → lubricating oil
questions.explanation: Fractions in increasing boiling point order: Petrol (lightest, ~70°C) → Kerosene → Diesel → Lubricating oil → Bitumen (heaviest, solid/semi-solid).

questions.question: A student says 'coal forms quickly underground in 100 years.' Is this correct?
options: No, coal takes millions of years to form
Yes, in tropical countries it forms in 100 years
questions.explanation: Coal takes millions of years to form through carbonisation of buried vegetation. 100 years is far too short.

questions.question: Which product from petroleum is used to make candles and Vaseline?
questions.explanation: Paraffin wax is a solid petroleum fraction used in making candles, wax coatings, Vaseline (petroleum jelly), and cosmetics.

questions.question: Why is CNG preferred over diesel for buses and trucks in cities?
options: CNG produces far less pollution (less SO₂, particulates) improving urban air quality
questions.explanation: CNG is preferred in cities because it reduces air pollution significantly — less SO₂ and particulates than diesel, improving public health.

questions.question: Match correctly: PCRA → ___
questions.explanation: PCRA (Petroleum Conservation Research Association) is an Indian government body focused on promoting conservation and efficient use of petroleum products.

questions.question: Which fuel comes from BOTH coal AND petroleum refining?
questions.explanation: Bitumen is obtained both from coal tar (coal processing) and as the heaviest residue in petroleum refining. Both sources provide bitumen for road construction.

questions.question: Natural gas and petroleum are often found together. Which is found above the other?
questions.explanation: Natural gas (being lighter) collects above petroleum in underground reservoirs, often forming a gas cap above the liquid crude oil.

questions.question: Identify the RENEWABLE energy source from the list:
questions.explanation: Solar energy is renewable — it comes from the sun and is not depleted by use. Coal, petroleum, and natural gas are non-renewable fossil fuels.

questions.question: Which of these uses LPG as fuel?
questions.explanation: LPG (in cylinders) is the primary cooking fuel in Indian households. Jets use kerosene (ATF); power plants use coal; CNG vehicles use compressed methane.

questions.question: What happens chemically when fossil fuels burn?
options: Carbon and hydrogen in fuels combine with oxygen to produce CO₂ and water
They release nitrogen into the air
questions.explanation: Combustion of fossil fuels: CₓHᵧ + O₂ → CO₂ + H₂O + energy. Carbon in fuels reacts with O₂ to form CO₂; hydrogen forms water.

questions.question: Which of these is a CORRECT conservation practice for petroleum products?
options: Leave vehicles running even when parked
Switch off engines at long traffic signals
Drive at maximum speed to save time
questions.explanation: Switching off engines at long stops saves fuel. Other conservation practices: keep tyres inflated, service vehicles regularly, carpool, use public transport.

questions.question: Which best explains why we call fossil fuels a 'stored form of solar energy'?
options: Ancient organisms captured solar energy through photosynthesis; fossilisation stored that energy in coal/petroleum
They are heated by the sun underground
They release solar radiation when burned
questions.explanation: Ancient plants captured solar energy via photosynthesis; animals ate those plants. When these organisms fossilised, that solar energy was stored as chemical energy in coal and petroleum.
